requirements.text: A track record of building and owning foundational systems that other engineers depended on, along with experience living with the consequences of those decisions
The ability to ramp quickly, operate in ambiguity, and make progress without needing problems fully specified up front
An understanding of the tension between ideal solutions and velocity, and the judgment to know when to pursue one over the other
An instinct for leverage, with a preference for systemic fixes over one-off solutions
A clear point of view on how engineers should work, and the drive to turn that into code, tooling, and defaults
Experience working closely with other engineers or teams as an enabler, not just as an implementer
A desire to help define and build the platform's direction, rather than execute against a tightly defined scope and fixed roadmap
Nice to have: experience building or owning internal platforms, developer tooling, or shared infrastructure
Nice to have: experience working on agentic systems, LLM platforms, or large-scale data ingestion pipelines
Nice to have: a track record of being the person people go to when systems get weird or unclear
